modules.name: User & Subscription Management
modules.responsibility: Manages user profiles, keywords, subscription dates, and Telegram session strings.

modules.name: Telegram Listener Engine (Producer)
modules.responsibility: Listens to assigned Telegram groups and pushes raw message data to Redis Queue immediately.

modules.name: Matching & NLP Engine (Consumer)
modules.responsibility: Fetches raw messages from Redis, normalizes text, compares keywords against Redis cache, and calculates match percentage.

modules.name: Notification Service
modules.responsibility: Sends high-score lead alerts directly to the user's Saved Messages or Notification Bot.

data_flow: User configures keywords via API/Bot -> Saved to PostgreSQL & cached in Redis
Listener catches group message -> Pushes JSON payload to Redis Queue
Celery Worker pops payload -> Evaluates against active keywords in Redis Cache
Match Score >= Threshold -> Triggers Notification Service to dispatch lead
